name: Blackpool Local Plan Part 1: Core Strategy 2012-2027

housing-numbers.notes: Housing requirement based on employment-led forecast. Windfall mainly from conversions and empty properties. South Blackpool sites include 600 homes at Moss House Road and 150 at Whyndyke Farm. Phased delivery: 250 homes/year 2012-2017, 280 homes/year 2017-2022, 310 homes/year 2022-2027. Specific site allocations to be detailed in separate Site Allocations DPD.
